## What you want

A clear description of the tool / endpoint / data field you'd like to see exposed.

## Use case

Why you want this — what problem does it solve, what AI agent prompt or workflow does it unlock? Concrete examples beat abstract requests.

## Example

If you can sketch the desired tool signature or endpoint, paste it here:

```json
{
  "tool_name": "get_xyz",
  "params": { "symbol": "VIC", "...": "..." },
  "expected_return": { "...": "..." }
}
```

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds have you tried? What other data sources have this feature? (Helps us understand the gap and prioritize.)

## Priority for you

- [ ] Blocking my current project
- [ ] Would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Nice to have eventually
